_about: The live look panel's sliders (LookPanel, N in game). From the art session's list, docs/briefs/look_settings.md: address (LookPreset), label, range, and what it does. kind: float (default), color, bool, or choice with options. Lamps are multipliers over each lamp's own value.

items.label: Sun strength
items.what: The sun's light at full height; scaled down near the horizon.

items.label: Sun arc tilt
items.what: How far the sun's arc leans from overhead (lower = a lower sun all day).

items.label: Sun arc turn
items.what: The arc turned round the vertical: at 20 the sun sets south of west.

items.label: Day length bias
items.what: Days a little longer than nights.

items.label: Sun in the haze
items.what: How much the sun lights the volumetric haze (rays down the street).

items.label: Sun scatter
items.what: How much the sun's colour scatters into the haze looking toward it.

items.label: Sun disc size
items.what: The sun disc's size, as a fraction of the sky.

items.label: Low sun: sky dims
items.what: How much the sky away from a low sun darkens.

items.label: Cloud cover
items.what: Share of sky under cloud.

items.label: Cloud size
items.what: Size of the cloud heaps (bigger = fewer, larger).

items.label: Cloud edges ragged
items.what: How much a finer noise eats the clouds' edges.

items.label: Cloud painted tones
items.what: 0 = shaded smoothly; 1 = three hard painted bands.

items.label: Cloud drift
items.what: How fast the clouds slide across the street.

items.label: Sky squares
items.what: The sky cut into squares (cells a radian); 0 = smooth.

items.label: Sky mosaic
items.what: A shade's worth of mosaic across those squares.

items.label: Moon strength
items.what: The moon's light when it's up.

items.label: Moonlight colour
items.what: The moonlight's colour.

items.label: Moon arc tilt
items.what: At 78 the moon crosses low and stands in the saloon's doorway near midnight.

items.label: Stars
items.what: Brightness of the stars.

items.label: Night ambient (open)
items.what: Ambient light at night in the open.

items.label: Night ambient (inside)
items.what: Ambient inside buildings at night.

items.label: Saloon's night fill
items.what: The saloon's own fill at night: the painting's room is dark and lit by its lamps.

items.label: Night exposure
items.what: The eye's exposure at night.

items.label: Backdrop at night
items.what: What the painted backdrop's land turns at night.

items.label: All lamps: light
items.what: × every lamp's own light.

items.label: Street lanterns: light
items.what: × the lamps outside and in the other buildings.

items.label: Saloon lamps: light
items.what: × the saloon's sconces, back-bar, hung and table lamps.

items.label: All lamps: reach
items.what: × how far each lamp's light reaches.

items.label: All lamps: glow in the air
items.what: × how much each lamp lights the haze round it.

items.label: Distance haze
items.what: Haze down the street.

items.label: Aerial perspective
items.what: How much far things take the sky's colour rather than the fog's.

items.label: Low sun haze gold
items.what: How bright the haze's gold is with the sun low.

items.label: Volumetric haze
items.what: The haze lamps and the sun light (Forward+ only).

items.label: Haze colour
items.what: The volumetric haze's own colour.

items.label: Haze distance
items.what: How far the volumetric haze is computed (m).

items.label: Haze takes ambient
items.what: How much ambient light the haze picks up.

items.label: Saloon smoke
items.what: Tobacco smoke in the saloon.

items.label: Backdrop haze
items.what: How much of the fog's colour lies over the painted backdrop.

items.label: Backdrop haze × fog
items.what: The backdrop's haze following the scene's fog density.

items.label: Glow
items.what: Strength of the glow off true emitters (chimney glass, the moon).

items.label: Glow threshold
items.what: Only pixels brighter than this bloom; at 1 lamp-lit things bloom too.

items.label: Bloom everything
items.what: A share of everything blooming; any of it veils the frame.

items.label: Glow: tight halo
items.what: The tight blur size's share of the glow.

items.label: Glow: wide halo
items.what: The wide blur size's share of the glow.

items.label: Glow blend
items.what: How the glow is laid over the frame.

items.label: Golden hour exposure
items.what: Exposure with the sun low (noon is 1).

items.label: Contrast
items.what: Contrast after the tonemap.

items.label: Saturation
items.what: Saturation after the tonemap.

items.label: Day ambient
items.what: Ambient light at noon.

items.label: Golden hour ambient
items.what: Ambient cut to this share of the day's with the sun low.

items.label: Golden hour: sky share
items.what: Share of that ambient from the sky (the rest warm bounce).

items.label: Warm bounce
items.what: How bright the warm bounce colour is.

items.label: Inside ambient (day)
items.what: Ambient inside buildings by day.

items.label: Corner shade reach
items.what: Screen-space ambient occlusion radius.

items.label: Corner shade
items.what: Screen-space ambient occlusion strength.

items.label: Backdrop shade colour
items.what: The backdrop's shadow side with the sun low.

items.label: Sun on the ground
items.what: The sun's direct light on the ground, scaled.

items.label: Sky fill on the ground
items.what: Unshadowed light on all the open ground.

items.label: Sun wrap
items.what: Wraps the sun's light round the ground's facing.

items.label: Dirt
items.what: The code-painted dirt; the tint the road tiles sit on.

items.label: Dark dirt
items.what: The darker dirt.

items.label: Scrub
items.what: Scrub on the ground.

items.label: Sage
items.what: Sage on the ground.

items.label: Light on painted men
items.what: Scene light × this on painted parts.

items.label: Ambient on painted men
items.what: How much of the scene's ambient reaches painted parts.

items.label: Light wrap
items.what: Light wrapped round him.

items.label: Brightness cap
items.what: No light makes him brighter than this × painted.

items.label: Self-lit
items.what: Share of him that glows as painted.

items.label: Light steps
items.what: Lambert stepped into this many tones (0 = smooth).

items.label: Screen mosaic (O)
items.what: The screen mosaic.

items.label: Quantise once (I)
items.what: Every pre-blocking step off, the mosaic refined (reloads the scene).

items.label: Probe mosaic (M, trial)
items.what: Blocks fixed to the world by direction from a grid-snapped point (texel splatting's idea); brings quantise once with it.

items.label: Probe texels a face
items.what: Cube texels a face: 384 gives 3.5 px blocks at the saloon shot's lens at 720p; fewer = bigger blocks.

items.label: Probe spacing (m)
items.what: Metres between the points the blocks are cut from: bigger = fewer re-cuts as you walk, more stretch up close.

items.label: Probe light bands
items.what: Lightness bands in OKLab (0 = smooth).

items.label: Tiles (P)
items.what: Light per texel, ragged tile edges, or smooth light.

items.label: Finish pass
items.what: Softens a render pixel on hard block edges.

items.label: Smallest square (px)
items.what: The smallest square a texel may draw on screen; 0 = off.

items.label: Tile raggedness
items.what: How far a ragged tile's centre wanders.

items.label: Light across a tile
items.what: A faint gradient of the real light across each tile.

items.label: Mosaic block size
items.what: Block size in render px × metres of depth.

items.label: Mosaic light tones
items.what: Tones the light is posterised into (0 = none).

items.label: Mosaic smallest block
items.what: The block size's floor (px).

items.label: Mosaic largest block
items.what: The block size's ceiling (px).

items.label: Mosaic depth power
items.what: 0.5 = nearly one size near and far.

items.label: Mosaic soft edges
items.what: Pixels of blend across block edges.

items.label: Mosaic: average a block
items.what: A block as the mean of its pixels rather than its centre.

items.label: Mosaic: keep the darks
items.what: Darker pixels weigh more in that mean.

items.label: Mosaic saturation steps
items.what: The block's colour snapped to a limited palette (0 = off).

items.label: Mosaic hue steps
items.what: Hue snapped to this many steps (0 = off).

items.label: Mosaic block indoors
items.what: Block size under a roof (quantise once).

items.label: Mosaic block outdoors
items.what: Block size in the open (quantise once).
